 2026 Governors Awards: Zendaya, Florence Pugh, more 
 By 
 Jacquelyn Kozak 
 Published 
 Nov. 15, 2026, 11:48 p.m. ET 
 The 2026 Governors Awards celebrated some of the biggest honors in film, such as lifetime cinema achievements, career-long contributions to the arts, and more. At this year’s ceremony, The Board of Governors honored Glenn Close, Ridley Scott, and more. Ahead, see what some of the biggest names in Hollywood wore on the red carpet.
